steps.title: The whole map
steps.body_html: PRs only, in three themed lanes and ten blocks by feature. Color is the PR status; animated arrows are dependencies that still block. Jira tickets and artifacts are linked from each PR's panel.

steps.title: ui-kit#1025 is holding up the map view
steps.body_html: It has bruno-soler's approval, but the requested changes still stand. #1027, #1028 and the new #1031 hang off its alpha version.

steps.title: Two paths to the same map
steps.body_html: #1027 (Bruno) and #1031 (Clara) both build the Warehouses map view. We need to decide which one goes ahead.

steps.title: #1003 unblocks three PRs
steps.body_html: It had 2 approvals, but on Sep 24 fcsonline requested changes: talk to the translations team about reusing the existing ones. Once it is merged, #1004, #1007 and, behind it, #1008 can move forward.

steps.title: Your geocoding chain
steps.body_html: #1017 creates the columns; #1018 resolves the ids; #1019, #1020 and #1021 (time zone) are stacked on top. The last three are drafts with no ticket cited: they fit under WH-119 and WH-118.

steps.title: #1029 can move forward now
steps.body_html: ui-kit#1030, the Google provider, was merged today. #1029 now only needs the ui-kit-react version bump and the lat/long fields from #1027.

steps.title: Jira does not reflect what happened
steps.body_html: PRs with a ⚠ warning have an out-of-sync ticket: ui-kit#1030 is merged while WH-122 is In Code Review; #1003 has WH-104 in Blocked; #1027, #1028, #1013, #1014 and #1016 have their ticket in To Do and unassigned; #1007 implements WH-111, which is still To Do. Open each PR to jump to its ticket.
